description: Screen a single name against global sanctions, PEP, and watchlists (OFAC, EU, UN, FATF, criminal, adverse media) for AML compliance. Returns scored entity matches with list metadata. Example: sanctions_search({ name: "Vladimir Putin", entity_type: "individual", min_score: 0.9, _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: sanctions.io API token (get one at https://api.sanctions.io/users/signup/)

country.description: Filter matches by country (ISO name or code), optional

data_source.description: Comma-separated watchlist source(s) to screen against, e.g. "OFAC-COMPREHENSIVE", "PEP", "FATF". Omit to search all subscribed lists.

date_of_birth.description: Filter individual matches by date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

identifier.description: Filter by a known identifier (passport, tax ID, registration number, etc.), optional

name.description: Name to screen (person or organization), e.g. "Vladimir Putin", "Acme Corp"

name: sanctions_search
title: Sanctions Search
